data.title: The Science of Brain Recovery: Neurobiology, Clinical Evidence, and Integrated Treatment for Addiction and Mental Health
data.description: For decades, substance dependence and chronic mood disorders were widely misunderstood as personal shortcomings or failures of willpower.
